milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the jungle sign at spawn-relative (2, 0, 2) and face it, modeling 'the player can see the sign'. max_distance=16 gives generous range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_wall_sign drops a 'dark_oak_sign' item into the player's inventory. Wall signs always drop as their corresponding standing sign item. The player starts with no dark_oak_sign, so having ≥1 confirms the block was mined.

Uses inventory_has because crafting jungle_stairs places the result into the player's inventory. The player starts with no jungle_stairs, so having ≥1 confirms successful crafting. Recipe: 6 jungle_planks in stair pattern on crafting table yields 4 jungle_stairs.
